title: Indianapolis Colts 10, Minnesota Vikings 16
recap:
The Minnesota Vikings secured a 16-10 win over the Indianapolis Colts at U.S. Bank Stadium. Key turning points came in the fourth quarter, as the Vikings took the lead with a T.J. Hockenson touchdown catch and sealed the win with a Will Reichard field goal.

Top performers included Colts running back Jonathan Taylor, who rushed for 95 yards and a touchdown, and Vikings quarterback Kyler Murray, who threw for 150 yards and a touchdown. The Vikings' Blake Cashman also made an impact with 2 sacks and 12 tackles, while the Colts' Adetomiwa Adebawore recorded 2 sacks. The final score was 16-10 in favor of the Vikings.
